messages:
pagerduty: INCIDENT ALERT: Prod gateway 5xx spike detected. Elevated TLS handshake failures (metric: gateway.tls.handshake_failures) across eu-west-1 and us-east-1. Paging @infra-oncall :rotating_light:

infra-oncall: acked — jumping on it now. attaching initial graphs. seeing 5xx rate ~4.3% -> 12% in last 3 mins.

maria.g: I’m seeing a lot of `tls: unknown certificate` and `x509: certificate has expired or is not yet valid` in gateway logs. sample: `2026-03-14T14:01:22Z gateway[proxy]: tls handshake error: remote error: tls: bad certificate`

eng-sre-bot: deploy event: `cert-rotator-job` completed 25m ago in eu-west-1 (job id: rot-20260314-2)

infra-oncall: possible correlation with rotator job. checking certs on gateway and backend mTLS trust store.

maria.g: I ran `openssl s_client -connect internal-backend.prod:443 -status -servername backend` from a gateway node and got: ```
CONNECTED(00000003)
depth=0 CN = redwood-backend-client
verify error:num=10:certificate has expired
notAfter=Mar 12 09:23:45 2026 GMT
---
```

infra-oncall: that confirms expired client cert. looks like one cert in the chain didn't rotate. impact: gateway rejects client auth -> 502/503 to clients.

tomas: tagging infra-sre. immediate mitigation options?

maria.g: short-term: disable client cert enforcement on edge gateway so we fallback to token-based auth (low risk for internal traffic?) — this will restore traffic but reduce mTLS guarantees. long-term: reissue new client cert and rotate trust anchors.

infra-oncall: proposing mitigation plan: 1) patch gateway config in eu-west-1 to set `requireClientCert=false` 2) confirm traffic and error rate drop 3) re-issue certs and re-enroll 4) re-enable and verify

deploy-bot: To patch: `kubectl -n gateway rollout restart deploy/prod-gateway -l region=eu-west-1` — patch command ready if approved.

liz.cs: CS note: we have a handful of paying customers on strict compliance. if we make the fallback change, we need to call out to them before full disable. Can we limit the fallback to non-compliant routes?

infra-oncall: good catch. we can patch a route-level flag for public-facing endpoints only. executing targeted change now on a small set of pods in eu-west-1. will monitor.

infra-oncall: executing: ```kubectl patch configmap gateway-config -n gateway --type=json -p='[ {"op":"replace","path":"/requireClientCert","value":false} ]'``` on eu-west-1 canaries

eng-sre-bot: patch applied to 3/3 canary pods in eu-west-1. watching metrics.

maria.g: post-patch check: 5xx trending back down in canaries from 11% -> 1.2% in 2 minutes. latency normalizing.

infra-oncall: rolling patch to remainder of eu-west-1 pool (10 pods).

eng-sre-bot: rollout complete. eu-west-1 5xx rate back to baseline ~0.9%. us-east-1 still showing small spikes — looks like rotator job ran there slightly later.

tomas: initiating cert re-issue for the expired client cert. Maria, can you coordinate with the rotator job to re-run for the failed bundle?

maria.g: on it. I’m rerunning rotator for both regions with `--force` to ensure the new cert is signed and distributed. watching the ACM/PKI job now.

eng-sre-bot: rotator job started: rot-20260314-2b. status: in-progress.

maria.g: rotator finished and new certs distributed. verifying expiry: `openssl x509 -in /etc/tls/new-client.crt -noout -dates` -> `notAfter=Mar 14 20:41:12 2028 GMT` — good.

infra-oncall: re-enabling client cert enforcement gradually in eu-west-1 canaries.

eng-sre-bot: re-enable applied to 3 canaries. monitoring.

maria.g: canary check shows stable handshake success. error rate remains low. re-enabling on remainder of pool.

infra-oncall: full re-enable complete in eu-west-1. us-east-1 rotator re-run finished and full re-enable scheduled now.

liz.cs: customer comms: I’ll draft a short note to affected customers: explain brief outage window, mitigation details, and next steps. Will wait for final confirmation from infra before sending.

tomas: taking over as primary on-call for follow-up. handover notes: verified cause = expired client certificate introduced by rotator edge case; mitigation = temporary disable client auth + forced re-issue; status = services recovered, error rates normalized; action items: create runbook to handle mid-rotation failures, add validation gate in rotator job, and notify compliance customers.

infra-oncall: leaving incident channel — ping me if you need the rotator job logs.

maria.g: creating PR for rotator improvements: add post-rollout cert validity check + automatic rollback of rotation if any node reports `certificate has expired` in last 24h.

tomas: severity set to P1 initially, downgraded to P2 after mitigation and customer outreach planned.

deploy-bot: incident closed by infra-sre-bot at 1923460899 — final RCA and follow-ups to be posted in #incidents-postmortems.

liz.cs: note: informed 3 customers via email; 1 requested further security assurance — will coordinate with security for audit trail.

maria.g: post-incident tasks created: I-3452 (rotator gate), I-3453 (runbook), I-3454 (alert tuning). linking to this thread.

tomas: thanks everyone. summary for the log: cause = rotator produced stale certificate in one region leading to mTLS validation failures; mitigation = targeted disable + cert re-issue; recovery = traffic returned to baseline within ~18 minutes; follow-ups assigned.

pagerduty: NOTE: incident timeline saved. please fill out postmortem template within 72h.
